notes: Actual India campus; crop removes excessive forest at the right while preserving academic buildings.
No visible recognizable people, flags, logos or religious symbols in the proposed crop.
Legacy asset key describes an older AI scene; update visible alt and source caption to the true aerial/daylight subject.
Actual United States university architecture; empty frame.
The photograph was made in 2007 and does not establish current campus conditions. Do not caption it as current or as a particular admission facility.
No recognizable people, logos, text, political or religious symbols in proposed crop.
Exact French description identifies the Desjardins pavilion, Quebec, Canada.
Empty modern exterior with incidental parking and traffic signs. No institutional logo or recognizable person.
Snow, not maple leaves; visible captions and alt must reflect the actual subject.
An actual UK campus example, not a depiction of all UK or Irish universities.
Empty scene; the real university name is carved above the entry and small banners occur near the path. These are incidental signage, with no prominent commercial brand or recognizable person.
Do not present this photograph as an unrelated institution.
The Netherlands is explicitly identified by the photographer and location metadata.
Original has people on the bridge; exact proposed crop excludes the entire occupied bridge segment.
Crop reviewed at 1400px width: no people, logos, flags or religious/political symbols.
Pre-2017 Unsplash CC0 status verified against the archived original publication, not inferred from today’s Unsplash terms.
Original contains people at ground level; proposed crop removes all of them and shows the upper facade and trees only.
The original EXIF contains a 2016 copyright string; the file-specific CC0 dedication and archived pre-license-change publication are the rights basis.
Decorative stone relief is architectural detail; no identifiable religious symbol was visible in the reviewed crop.
Exact photo title, creator description, and geolocation place this at Tokai University Shonan campus in Japan.
Original includes one person by the entrance and building number 19; proposed top crop removes both, keeping the academic exterior.
No recognizable people, logos, flags or religious/political symbols in proposed crop.
Reviewed CC0 campus candidates including Siberian State Technological University, Kyrgyz-Russian Slavic University, and other Russian campus results.

The Siberian candidate has Soviet-style decorative emblems, a statue, readable signage, and a recognizable foreground person; the Kyrgyz candidate has flags, an institutional installation/logo and low-quality haze.

Other candidates were low resolution, institutional signage, state/military campuses, religion, or otherwise weaker choices. Retaining already reviewed AI avoids forcing a replacement that fails the visual rules.
Reviewed a very relevant empty Texas A&M Qatar campus photo, photographer-released PD/CC0.

That dedication covers the photograph; it does not resolve the separately protected modern architecture in a jurisdiction lacking a general commercial freedom-of-panorama exception. Do not import without separate clearance.
Other searched UAE/Qatar/Oman/Bahrain/Saudi results were logos, identifiable people, non-CC0 works, low resolution, unrelated material, or similarly unresolved architectural subjects.
Original multi-megabyte JPEGs and visual-review contact sheets are ignored research files. Import only optimized final variants.
All crop rectangles use original-image pixels and exact 16:9 ratios.
Actual campus photographs must carry their true subject and source; root agent confirmed collegeImage selects only AI, preventing another campus from appearing as the named institution.
Source captions should be neutral factual descriptions with photographer/license links and no institutional endorsement claim.

finalIntegrationNotes.australia-nz: Retained AI. Independent official-building verification identified cherub relief friezes in the photograph; rejected under Rule C despite initial visual/source approval. The original AI asset was restored.
finalIntegrationNotes.east-southeast-asia: Retained AI. Tokai crop is dominated by branches and exceeds the 100 KiB AVIF ceiling at 1024px / quality 40; do not degrade a high quality source further merely to force a replacement.
finalIntegrationNotes.profiles: Only the explicitly bound Princeton, Manchester and University of Amsterdam photos appear on their exact profiles. Other profiles use academic AI scenes, never a different campus or destination landscape.
